reviewKind: static construction and actual record-shape compatibility only

preservedPriorFinding.issue: The failed-original evidence command could be any selected phase, while the selected rawProducer/rawSnapshot/observer pins were not tied to the failed command artifact roles.
preservedPriorFinding.resolution: V4 retains command pins by phase and compares exact path/bytes/SHA256 projections to p125k-fresh-canonical and its three artifact roles before those failure artifact reads. Existing log-path and raw-byte equality checks remain.

exactAdaptations.method: Read inert source and deltas, compare exact stdlib unified-diff text; do not import, parse, compile or execute helper.

constructionFindings: The base inventory is required to retain 1118 files, 1115 non-index payloads, 141 commands and 1568 ordered historical pins. Only three active metadata files and the checkpoint-window prefix are published as successors.

The 142 runtime inputs explicitly admit only the owned old-grant-to-import-only-grant successor; the other 141 and the original retained grant remain exact prerequisites. Nine prior natives plus the actual fresh native are hash/stat prerequisites, never payloads.

Actual source checkpoint, final EOF-only helper bytes, corrected canonical, manual controls, prepared/apply/classification/restore records, final preservation and whole-issue gaps are mandatory pinned inputs. Their finite field shapes match the inspected actual records.

Original source-combined and final source-after-eof observations remain distinct. The accepted canonical is the separately named corrected-path phase. Original fresh 17/4 is mandatory historical failure evidence excluded from acceptance; V4 binds its command and raw roles exactly.

The same ordered unique 21 identities and actual hook counts must join all source/fresh outcomes. Controls require actual RED, all-failure/masking review, explicit restoration, natural closure and chronology; no predicted failure totals or cohort sums are generated.

Recipe hashes, once-only replacements, live patch hash, regular single-link target identity, source/fresh physical distinction, compiled/native preservation and clean final trees are required records. This static review does not replace the independent runtime audit.

Public copying is limited to root-pinned public lifecycle/checkpoint/certificate/query/response allowlist entries. Private-run, raw child streams, signing/workspace files outside that allowlist, PEM/key files, raw originals, oversized ownership captures and native payloads are refused.

Literal private-key markers are checked before lossless log/patch encoding and again in final payloads. Helper source with that marker stays hash-only. Copied source must use inert .source.txt names; logs and patches use the existing lossless-original/1 envelope.

Output creation is exclusive after prerequisites. The script preserves the old README suffix and notes prefix, rechecks all 142 current input bytes before private assembly, and emits explicit later validator/index/whitespace/Git/publication requirements without claiming those checks occurred.
